book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 Korin Polho Duichon suraro Korin taun idungma ‘yuha’ yongo bapiya ngo irim togoc

content: Korin suraroho Yerusalem suraro tongfat yecyecha ecec möneng feng suran togung

Oro, son Kopotorochon kunkun suraro Yerusalem idangma yu tongfat yecyecha möneng feng suran toctocha yang. Nocho möneng feng suran toctochon yong fasun mata suraro Galesia provins idangma yu urop inogot. Son muyu worochon torocgon tonung. Wömai ingoroc:

Son owi amna tungu tungu Sönda danong möneng docno au Yerusalem suraroha siarut. Amna youpno tongitacmahon wöngnac morömahu o obmugon sogiditacma wömai inoin inoin torocdecgon singitnung. Ihoroc tongo idiya nocho ehaya sontho bongono wocinthagon forosingga möneng feng suran matoning. Muno, möneng wömai urop tong arangarang tongo fiuya noc ehangot.

Ehaya sontho amna au ‘möneng Yerusalem fongonung’ yongo soworeuya nocho amna worochon yong tuctuc mata au bapiyadec siaya yuho sogida tongo mönengot Yerusalem suraro imuya yuho embada amna worochon foro tuctugo kombinahing.
O nocho kombiaya angit ina, wömai nakaot yuot kondonggon Yerusalem ongonam.
Pol yu Korin suraro yacyacha kombigoc
Oro, nocho Masedonia provins kondong tongga suraro woce idangma yu yangga mit sonot ehangot.

Engmaina sonot bongono obmugon itmainahu o munohu wo wömai noc abe tuctugo makombit. O au wömai noc komöc sum bongono morö worocdec sonot engothu. Toya mit wömai sontho tongfat neuya nocho sa woce ongungot.
Inga ningo wömai nocho sonot bongono docutnogon iditha makombit. Muno, Morömaho kombiuna angit idinai wömai nocho bongono ubarago sonot engot.

Oro önga wömai Kopotorocho simbu fagarit namuna nocho Efesus taun ngocin suraro tongfat yecyec youp orongi sinom tongitat mahong amna koböcho ayam tong namongidang. Nocho ngocingon edeya ongga Pentikos bongono engoc.
Oro Timotiho sonot ehunai wömai sontho yu ogepgon angtorearut. Tuya yu sonot irot gucot engoc. Yuho wömai Morömahon youp orongi sinom tongitac. Nocho tongitat iho.
Worocha sonu yu ango angmurat toninga. Muno, son muyu yu tongfat yengo irot gucot inong muuya nocot ehangoc. Nocho yuha orin oröc noni auha ngocin torengga itat.

Oro nocho ‘oröc noni Apolos yuot oröc noni auot sonot ongonung’ yongo Apolos irotno sakangitat mahong yu inga ningo sonot onggonga abe irot yai kombihac. Wohong mit uyap au öngkung imunai wömai yu sonot ehangoc.
Mata madango au
Oro son soni woho, soni acacho itongga kombing tobic tobic soni kokorengga imu fatninga. Son yapmu auha botoninga, muno koing songga iditnung.
Irot tong fup imocimoc kiap worocho son kangtoreuna son manomano ambarac tongitnung.

Sonu Stefanashon feno kombing imang. Yu wömai Achaia gurocin osuc sinom irotno ibandung. Tongo yu ‘Kopotorochon owi amna tongfat yena’ yongo irotno youp worocha bogigung. Worocha wömai nocho mata orongi ingoroc kantiwa:
Son amna ihorocnomahon duc sumboditnung. O amna ambaracho yuot youp kondong tongidangma yuhon matano kombic kombicho itongitnung.
Oro, son ambaracho nocot ebepno maec. Worocha wömai nocho Stefanas o Fortunatus o Akaikus yu nocot ebungmaha irot ogep morö kombigot.
Yu nochon orin sonthon yaru noni imongtoc tuna nocho yuha borongdehat. Amna ihorocno woroc wömai sontho gending imongitnung.

Oro, Kopotorochon suraro Esia gurocin idangma yuho ‘irot ogep matano sonot ongoun’ yongo kombiang. O Akwila orin Prisila orin suraro yuho bucin suran tongidangma worocho ihorocgon sontha toup kombingga irot ogep matano siuya sonot ongeyac.
Oröc noni ambarac ngocin idangma yuho irot ogep matano siuya sonot ongeyac. Son Kopotorochon owi amna ambarac obu yopyop tarut.
Oro irot ogep mata madango ngo wömai noc Pol, nakain obunaho irim tat.
Amna au yu irotnoho Moröm noni maimongitacma yu wömai Kopotorocho möpmo impun. Öö Moröma noni, goc epi.
Yesu Duic Moröma noni yuhon irot gucnoho sonot itun.
Nochon irot kombic kombic ogepma sonot iditac. Yesu Duic yuhon mano woi boinno.
